present {\n\t\ttimedOut, isBool := v.(bool)\n\t\tif !isBool {\n\t\t\treturn Record{}, errors.New(\"result.timed_out is not a boolean\")\n\t\t}\n\t\tr.TimedOut = timedOut\n\t}","originalFile":"// Package logrecord decodes Drydock's JSON Lines execution log into records.\npackage logrecord\n\nimport (\n\t\"bytes\"\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n\t\"strings\"\n)\n\n// Record is one validated execution from the log, with numeric defaults applied.\ntype Record struct {\n\tExecutionID  string\n\tStartedAt    string\n\tStatus       string\n\tTarget       string\n\tCommand      string\n\tProvider     string\n\tModel        string\n\tReturnCode   *int64\n\tTimedOut     bool\n\tInputTokens  int64\n\tCachedTokens int64\n\tOutputTokens int64\n\tCostUSD      float64\n\tElapsedMS    int64\n}\n\n// Succeeded reports whether the record's status is \"succeeded\".\nfunc (r Record) Succeeded() bool {\n\treturn r.Status == \"succeeded\"\n}\n\n// StartDate returns the first 10 characters of started_at, the YYYY-MM-DD text used for grouping and filtering.\nfunc (r Record) StartDate() string {\n\tif len(r.StartedAt) < 10 {\n\t\treturn r.StartedAt\n\t}\n\treturn r.StartedAt[:10]\n}\n\n// requiredFields are the dotted paths that must each hold a non-empty string.\nvar requiredFields = []string{\"execution_id\", \"started_at\", \"status\", \"job.command_name\", \"job.target\"}\n\n// checkRequired reports the first required field that is absent, null, empty, or not a string.\nfunc checkRequired(obj map[string]any) error {\n\tfor _, path := range requiredFields {\n\t\tif s, ok := stringAt(obj, path); !ok || s == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"missing required field %s\", path)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// parseRecord validates one decoded JSON object and converts it to a Record.\nfunc parseRecord(obj map[string]any) (Record, error) {\n\tif err := checkRequired(obj); err != nil {\n\t\treturn Record{}, err\n\t}\n\n\tvar r Record\n\tr.ExecutionID, _ = stringAt(obj, \"execution_id\")\n\tr.StartedAt, _ = stringAt(obj, \"started_at\")\n\tr.Status, _ = stringAt(obj, \"status\")\n\tr.Command, _ = stringAt(obj, \"job.command_name\")\n\tr.Target, _ = stringAt(obj, \"job.target\")\n\tr.Provider, _ = stringAt(obj, \"job.llm\")\n\n\t// The executed model wins; the requested model is the fallback.\n\tr.Model, _ = stringAt(obj, \"job.model\")\n\tif executed, _ := stringAt(obj, \"result.stats.model\"); executed != \"\" {\n\t\tr.Model = executed\n\t}\n\n\tif _, present := valueAt(obj, \"result.returncode\"); present {\n\t\trc, err := intAt(obj, \"result.returncode\")\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn Record{}, err\n\t\t}\n\t\tr.ReturnCode = &rc\n\t}\n\n\tif _, present := valueAt(obj, \"result.timed_out\"); Blank lines are ignored. A line that is not a\n// valid record is counted in Skipped and described in Warnings, naming its line number. A\n// repeated execution_id is skipped after the first occurrence. Read returns an error only when\n// r itself cannot be read.\nfunc Read(r io.Reader) (Result, error) {\n\tvar res Result\n\tseen := make(map[string]bool)\n\n\tsc := bufio.NewScanner(r)\n\tsc.Buffer(make([]byte, 64*1024), maxLineBytes)\n\tline := 0\n\tfor sc.Scan() {\n\t\tline++\n\t\ttext := sc.Text()\n\t\tif strings.TrimSpace(text) == \"\" {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tobj, err := decodeObject(text)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tres.skip(line, err)\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\trec, err := parseRecord(obj)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tres.skip(line, err)\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif seen[rec.ExecutionID] {\n\t\t\tres.skip(line, fmt.Errorf(\"duplicate execution_id %q\", rec.ExecutionID))\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tseen[rec.ExecutionID] = true\n\t\tres.Records = append(res.Records, rec)\n\t}\n\tif err := sc.Err(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn Result{}, err\n\t}\n\treturn res, nil\n}\n\n// skip counts one skipped line and records its warning.\nfunc (r *Result) skip(line int, err error) {\n\tr.Skipped++\n\tr.Warnings = append(r.Warnings, fmt.Sprintf(\"line %d skipped: %v\", line, err))\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":339,"cache_read_input_tokens":76796,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":339},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"60ad454b-1b9f-4069-a05f-49039a4b7804","uuid":"c0c56743-5f48-4a01-b7e8-af1d086cf713","timestamp":"2026-10-24T16:08:03.340Z","request_id":"req_011CgMMJTjZGcYqwDbPgeoaa","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_017Cg1XsSLGDMUG4fvZ8cJQW":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261024.155305/build/DrydockStats/internal/logrecord/read.go","content":"package logrecord\n\nimport (\n\t\"bufio\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"strings\"\n)\n\n// maxLineBytes bounds one log line; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMMJvbbHcvynZPBRQCfs","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01CxXDQueXgDbbwpUF5Vp61H","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261024.155305/build/DrydockStats/internal/report/filter.go","content":"package report\n\nimport \"drydockstats/internal/logrecord\"\n\n// Filter narrows records by Target and by an inclusive start-date range.\ntype Filter struct {\n\tTarget    string\n\tHasTarget bool\n\tSince     string // YYYY-MM-DD; empty leaves the range open below\n\tUntil     string // YYYY-MM-DD; empty leaves the range open above\n}\n\n// Apply returns the records that pass every filter, in their original order.\nfunc Apply(records []logrecord.Record, f Filter) []logrecord.Record {\n\tkept := make([]logrecord.Record, 0, len(records))\n\tfor _, r := range records {\n\t\tif f.HasTarget && r.Target != f.Target {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tdate := r.StartDate()\n\t\tif f.Since != \"\" && date < f.Since {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif f.Until != \"\" && date > f.Until {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tkept = append(kept, r)\n\t}\n\treturn kept\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":566,"cache_read_input_tokens":78193,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":566},"output_tokens":16,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"60ad454b-1b9f-4069-a05f-49039a4b7804","uuid":"f8237003-3fc7-4e64-b0cb-e7c26fd47c91","timestamp":"2026-10-24T16:08:07.931Z","request_id":"req_011CgMMJvJj314wc2LCc2ac3","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01CxXDQueXgDbbwpUF5Vp61H":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261024.155305/build/DrydockStats/internal/report/filter.go","content":"package report\n\nimport \"drydockstats/internal/logrecord\"\n\n// Filter narrows records by Target and by an inclusive start-date range.\ntype Filter struct {\n\tTarget    string\n\tHasTarget bool\n\tSince     string // YYYY-MM-DD; empty leaves the range open below\n\tUntil     string // YYYY-MM-DD; empty leaves the range open above\n}\n\n// Apply returns the records that pass every filter, in their original order.\nfunc Apply(records []logrecord.Record, f Filter) []logrecord.Record {\n\tkept := make([]logrecord.Record, 0, len(records))\n\tfor _, r := range records {\n\t\tif f.HasTarget && r.Target != f.Target {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tdate := r.StartDate()\n\t\tif f.Since != \"\" && date < f.Since {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif f.Until != \"\" && date > f.Until {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tkept = append(kept, r)\n\t}\n\treturn kept\n}\n"}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01CxXDQueXgDbbwpUF5Vp61H","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261024.155305/build/DrydockStats/internal/report/filter.go (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"60ad454b-1b9f-4069-a05f-49039a4b7804","uuid":"2f25aef1-7496-486d-bcd3-d18772c08030","timestamp":"2026-10-24T16:08:08.016Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"create","filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261024.155305/build/DrydockStats/internal/report/filter.go","content":"package report\n\nimport \"drydockstats/internal/logrecord\"\n\n// Filter narrows records by Target and by an inclusive start-date range.\ntype Filter struct {\n\tTarget    string\n\tHasTarget bool\n\tSince     string // YYYY-MM-DD; empty leaves the range open below\n\tUntil     string // YYYY-MM-DD; empty leaves the range open above\n}\n\n// Apply returns the records that pass every filter, in their original order.\nfunc Apply(records []logrecord.Record, f Filter) []logrecord.Record {\n\tkept := make([]logrecord.Record, 0, len(records))\n\tfor _, r := range records {\n\t\tif f.HasTarget && r.Target != f.Target {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tdate := r.StartDate()\n\t\tif f.Since != \"\" && date < f.Since {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif f.Until != \"\" && date > f.Until {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tkept = append(kept, r)\n\t}\n\treturn kept\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01CxXDQueXgDbbwpUF5Vp61H","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{\n\tcalls, failed                    int64\n\tinput, cached, output, elapsedMS int64\n\tcostUSD                          float64\n}\n\nfunc (t *totals) add(r logrecord.Record) {\n\tt.calls++\n\tif !r.Succeeded() {\n\t\tt.failed++\n\t}\n\tt.input += r.InputTokens\n\tt.cached += r.CachedTokens\n\tt.output += r.OutputTokens\n\tt.elapsedMS += r.ElapsedMS\n\tt.costUSD += r.CostUSD\n}\n\nfunc (t totals) tokens() int64 {\n\treturn t.input + t.cached + t.output\n}\n\nfunc sumOf(records []logrecord.Record) totals {\n\tvar t totals\n\tfor _, r := range records {\n\t\tt.add(r)\n\t}\n\treturn t\n}\n\n// groupBy sums records into one totals value per key.\nfunc groupBy[K comparable](records []logrecord.Record, key func(logrecord.Record) K) map[K]*totals {\n\tgroups := make(map[K]*totals)\n\tfor _, r := range records {\n\t\tk := key(r)\n\t\tg, ok := groups[k]\n\t\tif !ok {\n\t\t\tg = &totals{}\n\t\t\tgroups[k] = g\n\t\t}\n\t\tg.add(r)\n\t}\n\treturn groups\n}\n\nfunc itoa(v int64) string {\n\treturn strconv.FormatInt(v, 10)\n}\n\nvar summaryHeader = []string{\"records\", \"skipped\", \"succeeded\", \"failed\", \"first\", \"last\",\n\t\"input_tokens\", \"cached_tokens\", \"output_tokens\", \"cost_usd\", \"minutes\"}\n\n// Summary writes one data row over the filtered records; skipped counts the whole file.\nfunc Summary(records []logrecord.Record, skipped int) [][]string {\n\tt := sumOf(records)\n\tfirst, last := \"\", \"\"\n\tfor i, r := range records {\n\t\tdate := r.StartDate()\n\t\tif i == 0 || date < first {\n\t\t\tfirst = date\n\t\t}\n\t\tif i == 0 || date > last {\n\t\t\tlast = date\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn [][]string{\n\t\tsummaryHeader,\n\t\t{itoa(t.calls), itoa(int64(skipped)), itoa(t.calls - t.failed), itoa(t.failed), first, last,\n\t\t\titoa(t.input), itoa(t.cached), itoa(t.output), FormatCost(t.costUSD), FormatMinutes(t.elapsedMS)},\n\t}\n}\n\nvar commandsHeader = []string{\"command\", \"calls\", \"failed\", \"input_tokens\", \"cached_tokens\", \"output_tokens\", \"minutes\"}\n\n// Commands writes one row per job.command_name, most calls first, then command ascending.\nfunc Commands(records []logrecord.Record) [][]string {\n\tgroups := groupBy(records, func(r logrecord.Record) string { return r.Command })\n\tnames := make([]string, 0, len(groups))\n\tfor name := range groups {\n\t\tnames = append(names, name)\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(names, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\ta, b := groups[names[i]].calls, groups[names[j]].calls\n\t\tif a != b {\n\t\t\treturn a > b\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn names[i] < names[j]\n\t})\n\n\trows := [][]string{commandsHeader}\n\tfor _, name := range names {\n\t\tg := groups[name]\n\t\trows = append(rows, []string{name, itoa(g.calls), itoa(g.failed), itoa(g.input), itoa(g.cached),\n\t\t\titoa(g.output), FormatMinutes(g.elapsedMS)})\n\t}\n\tt := sumOf(records)\n\treturn append(rows, []string{\"TOTAL\", itoa(t.calls), itoa(t.failed), itoa(t.input), itoa(t.cached),\n\t\titoa(t.output), FormatMinutes(t.elapsedMS)})\n}\n\nvar targetsHeader = []string{\"target\", \"calls\", \"failed\", \"input_tokens\", \"cached_tokens\", \"output_tokens\", \"cost_usd\", \"minutes\"}\n\n// Targets writes one row per job.target, ordered byte-wise ascending.\nfunc Targets(records []logrecord.Record) [][]string {\n\tgroups := groupBy(records, func(r logrecord.Record) string { return r.Target })\n\tnames := make([]string, 0, len(groups))\n\tfor name := range groups {\n\t\tnames = append(names, name)\n\t}\n\tslices.Sort(names)\n\n\trows := [][]string{targetsHeader}\n\tfor _, name := range names {\n\t\tg := groups[name]\n\t\trows = append(rows, []string{name, itoa(g.calls), itoa(g.failed), itoa(g.input), itoa(g.cached),\n\t\t\titoa(g.output), FormatCost(g.costUSD), FormatMinutes(g.elapsedMS)})\n\t}\n\tt := sumOf(records)\n\treturn append(rows, []string{\"TOTAL\", itoa(t.calls), itoa(t.failed), itoa(t.input), itoa(t.cached),\n\t\titoa(t.output), FormatCost(t.costUSD), FormatMinutes(t.elapsedMS)})\n}\n\nvar dailyHeader = []string{\"date\", \"calls\", \"failed\", \"tokens\", \"minutes\"}\n\n// Daily writes one row per start date, ordered ascending.\nfunc Daily(records []logrecord.Record) [][]string {\n\tgroups := groupBy(records, func(r logrecord.Record) string { return r.StartDate() })\n\tdates := make([]string, 0, len(groups))\n\tfor date := range groups {\n\t\tdates = append(dates, date)\n\t}\n\tslices.Sort(dates)\n\n\trows := [][]string{dailyHeader}\n\tfor _, date := range dates {\n\t\tg := groups[date]\n\t\trows = append(rows, []string{date, itoa(g.calls), itoa(g.failed), itoa(g.tokens()), FormatMinutes(g.elapsedMS)})\n\t}\n\tt := sumOf(records)\n\treturn append(rows, []string{\"TOTAL\", itoa(t.calls), itoa(t.failed), itoa(t.tokens()), FormatMinutes(t.elapsedMS)})\n}\n\nvar modelsHeader = []string{\"provider\", \"model\", \"calls\", \"failed\", \"input_tokens\", \"cached_tokens\", \"output_tokens\", \"cost_usd\"}\n\n// providerModel is the grouping key of the models report.\ntype providerModel struct {\n\tprovider, model string\n}\n\n// Models writes one row per provider and attributed model, ordered by provider then model.\nfunc Models(records []logrecord.Record) [][]string {\n\tgroups := groupBy(records, func(r logrecord.Record) providerModel {\n\t\treturn providerModel{provider: r.Provider, model: r.Model}\n\t})\n\tkeys := make([]providerModel, 0, len(groups))\n\tfor k := range groups {\n\t\tkeys = append(keys, k)\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(keys, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\tif keys[i].provider != keys[j].provider {\n\t\t\treturn keys[i].provider < keys[j].provider\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn keys[i].model < keys[j].model\n\t})\n\n\trows := [][]string{modelsHeader}\n\tfor _, k := range keys {\n\t\tg := groups[k]\n\t\trows = append(rows, []string{k.provider, k.model, itoa(g.calls), itoa(g.failed), itoa(g.input),\n\t\t\titoa(g.cached), itoa(g.output), FormatCost(g.costUSD)})\n\t}\n\tt := sumOf(records)\n\treturn append(rows, []string{\"TOTAL\", \"\", itoa(t.calls), itoa(t.failed), itoa(t.input), itoa(t.cached),\n\t\titoa(t.output), FormatCost(t.costUSD)})\n}\n\nvar failuresHeader = []string{\"started_at\", \"target\", \"command\", \"model\", \"returncode\", \"timed_out\"}\n\n// Failures itoa(*r.ReturnCode)\n\t\t}\n\t\ttimedOut := \"false\"\n\t\tif r.TimedOut {\n\t\t\ttimedOut = \"true\"\n\t\t}\n\t\trows = append(rows, []string{r.StartedAt, r.Target, r.Command, r.Model, returnCode, logrecord\n\nimport (\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\n// line builds one valid record line, with overrides applied by the caller.\nconst validLine = `{\"schema_version\":1,\"execution_id\":\"%s\",\"started_at\":\"2026-10-14T01:00:00.000Z\",` +\n\t`\"status\":\"succeeded\",\"job\":{\"command_name\":\"build\",\"target\":\"Toml\",\"llm\":\"claude\",\"model\":\"haiku\"},` +\n\t`\"result\":{\"returncode\":0,\"timed_out\":false,\"stats\":{\"model\":\"claude-haiku-5-5\",\"input_tokens\":10,` +\n\t`\"cached_input_tokens\":20,\"output_tokens\":30,\"cost_usd\":0.25,\"elapsed_ms\":1500}}}`\n\nfunc valid(id string) string {\n\treturn strings.Replace(validLine, \"%s\", id, 1)\n}\n\nfunc mustRead(t *testing.T, input string) Result {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tres, err := Read(strings.NewReader(input))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Read returned error: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn res\n}\n\nfunc TestReadDecodesOneRecordPerLine(t *testing.T) {\n\tres := mustRead(t, valid(\"a\")+\"\\n\"+valid(\"b\")+\"\\n\")\n\tif len(res.Records) != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"records = %d, want 2\", len(res.Records))\n\t}\n\tif res.Records[0].ExecutionID != \"a\" || res.Records[1].ExecutionID != \"b\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"ids = %q, %q; want a, b in file order\", res.Records[0].ExecutionID, res.Records[1].ExecutionID)\n\t}\n\tif res.Skipped != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"skipped = %d, want 0\", res.Skipped)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadIgnoresBlankLinesWithoutCountingThem(t *testing.T) {\n\tres := mustRead(t, \"\\n\"+valid(\"a\")+\"\\n   \\n\\t\\n\"+valid(\"b\")+\"\\n\\n\")\n\tif len(res.Records) != 2 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"records = %d, want 2\", len(res.Records))\n\t}\n\tif res.Skipped != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"skipped = %d, want 0\", res.Skipped)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadEmptyInputYieldsNoRecords(t *testing.T) {\n\tres := mustRead(t, \"\")\n\tif len(res.Records) != 0 || res.Skipped != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"got %d records, %d skipped; want 0, 0\", len(res.Records), res.Skipped)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadSkipsLinesThatAreNotJSONObjects(t *testing.T) {\n\tcases := map[string]string{\n\t\t\"not json\":          \"not json at all\",\n\t\t\"json array\":        `[1,2,3]`,\n\t\t\"json scalar\":       `42`,\n\t\t\"trailing data\":     valid(\"x\") + \" extra\",\n\t\t\"truncated object\":  `{\"execution_id\":\"x\"`,\n\t}\n\tfor name, bad := range cases {\n\t\tt.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {\n\t\t\tres := mustRead(t, bad+\"\\n\"+valid(\"ok\")+\"\\n\")\n\t\t\tif res.Skipped != 1 {\n\t\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"skipped = %d, want 1\", res.Skipped)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif len(res.Records) != 1 || res.Records[0].ExecutionID != \"ok\" {\n\t\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"records = %+v, want only ok\", res.Records)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadWarningNamesTheLineNumber(t *testing.T) {\n\tres := mustRead(t, valid(\"a\")+\"\\n\\nnot json\\n\")\n\tif len(res.Warnings) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"warnings = %d, want 1\", len(res.Warnings))\n\t}\n\tif !strings.HasPrefix(res.Warnings[0], \"line 3 \") {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"warning = %q, want it to name line 3\", res.Warnings[0])\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadSkipsRecordsMissingEachRequiredField(t *testing.T) {\n\tcases := map[string]string{\n\t\t\"execution_id\":     `{\"started_at\":\"2026-10-14T00:00:00.000Z\",\"status\":\"succeeded\",\"job\":{\"command_name\":\"b\",\"target\":\"T\"}}`,\n\t\t\"started_at\":       `{\"execution_id\":\"x\",\"status\":\"succeeded\",\"job\":{\"command_name\":\"b\",\"target\":\"T\"}}`,\n\t\t\"status\":           `{\"execution_id\":\"x\",\"started_at\":\"2026-10-14T00:00:00.000Z\",\"job\":{\"command_name\":\"b\",\"target\":\"T\"}}`,\n\t\t\"job.command_name\": `{\"execution_id\":\"x\",\"started_at\":\"2026-10-14T00:00:00.000Z\",\"status\":\"succeeded\",\"job\":{\"target\":\"T\"}}`,\n\t\t\"job.target\":       `{\"execution_id\":\"x\",\"started_at\":\"2026-10-14T00:00:00.000Z\",\"status\":\"succeeded\",\"job\":{\"command_name\":\"b\"}}`,\n\t\t\"empty job.target\": `{\"execution_id\":\"x\",\"started_at\":\"2026-10-14T00:00:00.000Z\",\"status\":\"succeeded\",\"job\":{\"command_name\":\"b\",\"target\":\"\"}}`,\n\t\t\"null target\":      `{\"execution_id\":\"x\",\"started_at\":\"2026-10-14T00:00:00.000Z\",\"status\":\"succeeded\",\"job\":{\"command_name\":\"b\",\"target\":null}}`,\n\t\t\"non-string id\":    `{\"execution_id\":7,\"started_at\":\"2026-10-14T00:00:00.000Z\",\"status\":\"succeeded\",\"job\":{\"command_name\":\"b\",\"target\":\"T\"}}`,\n\t\t\"no job object\":    `{\"execution_id\":\"x\",\"started_at\":\"2026-10-14T00:00:00.000Z\",\"status\":\"succeeded\"}`,\n\t}\n\tfor name, bad := range cases {\n\t\tt.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {\n\t\t\tres := mustRead(t, bad+\"\\n\")\n\t\t\tif len(res.Records) != 0 {\n\t\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"records = %d, want 0\", len(res.Records))\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif res.Skipped != 1 {\n\t\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"skipped = %d, want 1\", res.Skipped)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadDuplicateExecutionIDKeepsFirstOccurrence(t *testing.T) {\n\tfirst := strings.Replace(valid(\"dup\"), `\"status\":\"succeeded\"`, `\"status\":\"failed\"`, 1)\n\tsecond := valid(\"dup\")\n\tres := mustRead(t, first+\"\\n\"+second+\"\\n\"+valid(\"other\")+\"\\n\")\n\tif len(res.Records) != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"records = %d, want 2\", len(res.Records))\n\t}\n\tif res.Records[0].Status != \"failed\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"kept status = %q, want the first occurrence's failed\", res.Records[0].Status)\n\t}\n\tif res.Skipped != 1 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"skipped = %d, want 1\", res.Skipped)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadDuplicateCheckIgnoresLinesThatFailedValidation(t *testing.T) {\n\tinvalidFirst := `{\"execution_id\":\"dup\",\"started_at\":\"2026-10-14T00:00:00.000Z\",\"status\":\"succeeded\",\"job\":{\"command_name\":\"b\"}}`\n\tres := mustRead(t, invalidFirst+\"\\n\"+valid(\"dup\")+\"\\n\")\n\tif len(res.Records) != 1 || res.Records[0].ExecutionID != \"dup\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"records = %+v, want the later valid dup kept\", res.Records)\n\t}\n\tif res.Skipped != 1 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"skipped = %d, want 1\", res.Skipped)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadNullAndAbsentNumericsAreZero(t *testing.T) {\n\tnullCost := `{\"execution_id\":\"n\",\"started_at\":\"2026-10-14T00:00:00.000Z\",\"status\":\"succeeded\",` +\n\t\t`\"job\":{\"command_name\":\"b\",\"target\":\"T\"},\"result\":{\"stats\":{\"cost_usd\":null,\"input_tokens\":null}}}`\n\tnoStats := `{\"execution_id\":\"m\",\"started_at\":\"2026-10-14T00:00:00.000Z\",\"status\":\"succeeded\",` +\n\t\t`\"job\":{\"command_name\":\"b\",\"target\":\"T\"},\"result\":{\"returncode\":0}}`\n\tnoResult := `{\"execution_id\":\"r\",\"started_at\":\"2026-10-14T00:00:00.000Z\",\"status\":\"failed\",` +\n\t\t`\"job\":{\"command_name\":\"b\",\"target\":\"T\"}}`\n\tres := mustRead(t, nullCost+\"\\n\"+noStats+\"\\n\"+noResult+\"\\n\")\n\tif len(res.Records) != 3 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"records = %d, want 3; records with no stats are still records\", len(res.Records))\n\t}\n\tfor _, r := range res.Records {\n\t\tif r.CostUSD != 0 || r.InputTokens != 0 || r.CachedTokens != 0 || r.OutputTokens != 0 || r.ElapsedMS != 0 {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"record %s numerics = %+v, want all zero\", r.ExecutionID, r)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadNonNumericStatsAreSkipped(t *testing.T) {\n\tbad := `{\"execution_id\":\"s\",\"started_at\":\"2026-10-14T00:00:00.000Z\",\"status\":\"succeeded\",` +\n\t\t`\"job\":{\"command_name\":\"b\",\"target\":\"T\"},\"result\":{\"stats\":{\"input_tokens\":\"ten\"}}}`\n\tres := mustRead(t, bad+\"\\n\")\n\tif len(res.Records) != 0 || res.Skipped != 1 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"records = %d, skipped = %d; want 0, 1\", len(res.Records), res.Skipped)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadModelPrefersExecutedModel(t *testing.T) {\n\tres := mustRead(t, valid(\"a\")+\"\\n\")\n\tr := res.Records[0]\n\tif r.Model != \"claude-haiku-5-5\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"model = %q, want executed claude-haiku-5-5\", r.Model)\n\t}\n\tif r.Provider != \"claude\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"provider = %q, want claude\", r.Provider)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadModelFallsBackToRequestedWhenExecutedMissingOrEmpty(t *testing.T) {\n\tempty := strings.Replace(valid(\"e\"), `\"model\":\"claude-haiku-5-5\"`, `\"model\":\"\"`, 1)\n\tnoStats := `{\"execution_id\":\"f\",\"started_at\":\"2026-10-14T00:00:00.000Z\",\"status\":\"succeeded\",` +\n\t\t`\"job\":{\"command_name\":\"b\",\"target\":\"T\",\"llm\":\"codex\",\"model\":\"gpt-5.6-luna\"}}`\n\tres := mustRead(t, empty+\"\\n\"+noStats+\"\\n\")\n\tif res.Records[0].Model != \"claude-haiku-5-5\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"empty stats.model: model = %q, want the executed value kept\", res.Records[0].Model)\n\t}\n\tif res.Records[1].Model != \"gpt-5.6-luna\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"absent stats.model: model = %q, want requested gpt-5.6-luna\", res.Records[1].Model)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadAbsentProviderIsEmpty(t *testing.T) {\n\tline := `{\"execution_id\":\"p\",\"started_at\":\"2026-10-14T00:00:00.000Z\",\"status\":\"succeeded\",` +\n\t\t`\"job\":{\"command_name\":\"b\",\"target\":\"T\",\"model\":\"haiku\"}}`\n\tres := mustRead(t, line+\"\\n\")\n\tif res.Records[0].Provider != \"\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"provider = %q, want empty\", res.Records[0].Provider)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadReturnCodeNullIsNil(t *testing.T) {\n\tline := `{\"execution_id\":\"rc\",\"started_at\":\"2026-10-14T00:00:00.000Z\",\"status\":\"failed\",` +\n\t\t`\"job\":{\"command_name\":\"b\",\"target\":\"T\"},\"result\":{\"returncode\":null,\"timed_out\":true}}`\n\tres := mustRead(t, line+\"\\n\")\n\tr := res.Records[0]\n\tif r.ReturnCode != nil {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMMMwMp32yG4yvYrd73f","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_019Te9VPVYJ3HciaLqGnd7Ca","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261024.155305/build/DrydockStats/internal/report/report_test.go","content":"package report\n\nimport (\n\t\"bytes\"\n\t\"encoding/csv\"\n\t\"reflect\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"drydockstats/internal/logrecord\"\n)\n\n// rec builds a record with the given identity and numeric values.\nfunc rec(id, target, command, started string, status string, in, cached, out, elapsed int64, cost float64) logrecord.Record {\n\treturn logrecord.Record{\n\t\tExecutionID: id, StartedAt: started, Status: status, Target: target, Command: command,\n\t\tProvider: \"claude\", Model: \"haiku\",\n\t\tInputTokens: in, CachedTokens: cached, OutputTokens: out, ElapsedMS: elapsed, CostUSD: cost,\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestFormatMinutesRoundsHalfUpToTenths(t *testing.T) {\n\tcases := map[int64]string{\n\t\t0:      \"0.0\",\n\t\t2999:   \"0.0\",\n\t\t3000:   \"0.1\", // (3000+3000)/6000 = 1\n\t\t95000:  \"1.6\", // 98000/6000 = 16\n\t\t60000:  \"1.0\",\n\t\t600000: \"10.0\",\n\t}\n\tfor ms, want := range cases {\n\t\tif got := FormatMinutes(ms); got != want {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"FormatMinutes(%d) = %q, want %q\", ms, got, want)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestFormatCostHasFourPlaces(t *testing.T) {\n\tcases := map[float64]string{\n\t\t0:      \"0.0000\",\n\t\t5.5245: \"5.5245\",\n\t\t0.1:    \"0.1000\",\n\t}\n\tfor usd, want := range cases {\n\t\tif got := FormatCost(usd); got != want {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"FormatCost(%v) = %q, want %q\",
